title: Leadership Identity Profile™
intro: Name how you lead, what you stand for and what you will not trade.

nodes.prompt: Which describe how people experience your leadership?
What do people come to you for?
What do you do so naturally you rarely name it?
What do you believe about people and work that shapes your decisions?
What cause or purpose would you keep working on even when it was hard?
Which of your convictions is the least negotiable?
